candidate_windows.window_text: The dataset is divided into 75:15:15 split and the splits are speaker independent. Binary cross entropy is used as loss function. We experiment with $\{32,56,128,256,512\}$ hidden dimensions for the unimodal LSTM's, [2-11] heads for the MultiHead Self Attention Layer, $\{0.05,0.08,0.1,0.2,0.15,0.3,0.25\}$ dropout values and $\{1e - 2,e - 3,e - 4\}$ learning rates. The search space of the baseline models are given in the supplementary materials. All experiments are run on K80 gpus.
